repliker.halsning: The runes sleep, child. But they dream.
rader: Three stones once held back the night. They can do it again.
Don't walk between the stones after dark unless you know what you're doing.
The ash fell for weeks. We breathed it. Some of us were never the same.
I remember Ashenhold before it burned. You could hear the bells from here.

quest_krokar: What became of the Runecarver?
Ylva's vision: a fourth stone, somewhere in Ashenhold.

sokare.halsning: The Fourth Stone, child. Everything comes back to the Fourth Stone.
sokare.bark: He put it out himself. Himself.

gamla_ylva.name: Old Ylva
gamla_ylva.default_line: The runes sleep, child. But they dream.

repliker.halsning: Got gold? Then I've got goods. If not, have a pleasant day.
rader: Everything has a price. Even what you find on the dead.
I buy bones. Don't ask why.
Arrows? Sure. Smoked haunch? If you can afford it.

quest_krokar: Tor is looking for his old cart horse, which bolted toward Wolfstead.
tor_kolare.name: Tor the Collier
tor_kolare.default_line: Got gold? Then I've got goods. If not, have a pleasant day.

repliker.halsning: Sit down. Let me look at you.
rader: I can heal wounds, not the Blight. Remember that.
If a bite turns green, come to me at once.
The ash settles in your lungs. Breathe through cloth in Ashenhold.

quest_krokar: Sigrun wants herbs from the bogs of Mistshore.
sigrun_helare.name: Sigrun
sigrun_helare.default_line: Sit down. Let me look at you.

repliker.halsning: Keep to the path. The forest is hungry.
rader: More wolves since the runes went dark.
I saw a skeleton by a cairn to the north. It looked back.
If you go to Wolfstead, go by daylight.

quest_krokar: Bror's son vanished in Wolfstead.

bitter.halsning: You chose the huntress. Be on your way.

fridfull.halsning: He rests now. Thanks to you.
fridfull.bark: A good night for the watch.

bror_vakt.name: Bror
bror_vakt.default_line: Keep to the path. The forest is hungry.

repliker.halsning: Have you seen my brother? He had new sandals.
rader: He ran ahead of me. He was always the fastest.
Ylva says I shouldn't wait. I wait anyway.
The wolves sang that night.

quest_krokar: If the hero finds the Runaway's Sandals, Mira has something to say.

hjalper_sigrun.halsning: I help Sigrun now. She says I have gentle hands.

vandrar_mot_vargaby.halsning: He isn't here. But you said he was here.
vandrar_mot_vargaby.bark: Has anyone seen a boy in new sandals?

lilla_mira.name: Little Mira
lilla_mira.default_line: Have you seen my brother? He had new sandals.

repliker.halsning: Nine days we walked. Without you it would have been ten, and then no more.
rader: The cart made it. It's all we have.
The wolves followed us all the way to the huts.
It's warm here. That's enough.

bybo_flykting.name: Refugee by the Fire
bybo_flykting.default_line: Nine days we walked. Without you it would have been ten, and then no more.

repliker.halsning: Do you hear them? No. You never hear.
rader: The bones remember. The bones never lie.
I lived in Wolfstead. Now I live here. The wolves leave me be.
My garb? It's elsewhere now. It's waiting for you.

quest_krokar: The Whisperer speaks of the Bonewhisperer's Garb and the whispers of the dead.

lugn.halsning: It's quiet now. I'd forgotten what quiet sounds like.
lugn.bark: Warm yourself. The fire doesn't whisper.

besatt.halsning: The skull talks to you now, not to me. Do you hear?
besatt.bark: He chose you. He chose you.

viskaren.name: The Whisperer
viskaren.default_line: Do you hear them? No. You never hear.

repliker.halsning: Fur, bone, arrows. That's all Wolfstead has now.
rader: I buy anything that came off an animal.
The grey wolves are led by a big male with a chain around his neck.
Ulvhild ate my husband. I hope she choked.

quest_krokar: Hedda wants Ulvhild's pelt.

lamnar.halsning: Wolfstead has nothing left for me. At least there's fish here.

hedda_jagare.name: Hedda
hedda_jagare.default_line: Fur, bone, arrows. That's all Wolfstead has now.

repliker.halsning: No one should come here. Yet here you are.
rader: We guarded the dead for two hundred years. We were too few when they woke.
Valdemar was a good chieftain. It's the crown that rules him now.
Crush the bones. Don't pierce. Spears pass right through them.

quest_krokar: Ebbe wants Valdemar given a proper burial.
Gravewarden's Legacy: Ebbe knows where the wardens fell.

berattar_for_barn.halsning: The children want the Chronicle again. Sit with us.
berattar_for_barn.bark: And Ebbe's brothers held, to the last man.

dod.miljo: Ebbe's lantern stands dark by the portal.

gravvaktaren_ebbe.name: Ebbe the Gravewarden
gravvaktaren_ebbe.default_line: No one should come here. Yet here you are.

repliker.halsning: New faces! New faces at last!
rader: The village still smells of bone, but people are coming back.
I sell what I have, I buy what you have.
Heard what Olle says about Mistshore?

quest_krokar: Marta misses her daughter, who fled to Copperfell.
marta_torghandlare.name: Marta
marta_torghandlare.default_line: New faces! New faces at last!

repliker.halsning: I don't forge anymore. But I sell.
rader: My master forged the Runeforged Blade. He died that same night.
No forge burns in this village while I live. I've seen what fire does.
I buy weapons. Anything you pry off the dead.

quest_krokar: Gunnar's master's sword, the Runeforged Blade, should come home.
gunnar_jarnhand.name: Gunnar Ironhand
gunnar_jarnhand.default_line: I don't forge anymore. But I sell.

repliker.halsning: This village is under my protection. Act accordingly.
rader: My guards are farmers with spears. But they hold.
My grandfather was a Gravewarden. Ebbe knew him.
If you see anything move in the graveyard, tell me.

quest_krokar: Ingrid wants to know what happened to her grandfather.

gravvaktare.halsning: The Gravewardens live on in us now. Crush the bones, don't pierce.

vaktar_porten.halsning: Ebbe is dead. Someone must guard the gate.
vaktar_porten.bark: The lantern will burn again. One day.

vaktkapten_ingrid.name: Ingrid
vaktkapten_ingrid.default_line: This village is under my protection. Act accordingly.

repliker.halsning: Sit! First tankard's on me, the next one's on you.
rader: I hear everything. Half of it's lies. The other half's worse.
Folk say someone's seen light in Ashenhold again.
A hunter told me the bells of Mistshore toll beneath the water.

quest_krokar: The tavern board: hooks to every town.
olle_vardshus.name: Olle
olle_vardshus.default_line: Sit! First tankard's on me, the next one's on you.

rader: I sell what the dead wore.
The Whisperer was my teacher, before he lost his way.
Come at night. The bones speak clearer then.

quest_krokar: Sara wants to buy the Crown of the Bone King, but only to bury it.

altare.halsning: Valdemar speaks to me now. He is very angry. Care to buy something?

sara_benlasare.name: Sara

repliker.halsning: Don't go too near the water. It pulls.
rader: My husband drowned. Now he walks up the shore at night.
The ravens wait on the rooftops. For what, no one knows.
The Bog Queen sings. Have you heard her?

quest_krokar: Lova's husband among the drowned.
The Raven Mother's Bow.
lova_fiskarankan.name: Lova the Fisher's Widow
lova_fiskarankan.default_line: Don't go too near the water. It pulls.

repliker.halsning: The Lord has forgotten this mountain. I have not.
rader: The brothers locked themselves in so they would not be twisted. I was the only one who opened the door.
The spiders hear you walk. Tread lightly.
The brother with the iron girdle was the strongest of us.

quest_krokar: The Iron Monk's Girdle, and what happened in the cloister.
broder_elias.name: Brother Elias
broder_elias.default_line: The Lord has forgotten this mountain. I have not.

repliker.halsning: Don't tell them I'm here. Please.
rader: I was one of the Children of Ash. I believed the fire made us pure.
Morvath sits in the ruined cathedral. He's not waiting for anything. He just burns.
The pilgrim walked past me. He greeted me. No one greets anyone in Ashenhold.

quest_krokar: Rask knows where the Ashwalker's Burden was scattered.
The cult's rites around the Fourth Stone.
rask_avfallen.name: Rask the Apostate
rask_avfallen.default_line: Don't tell them I'm here. Please.

repliker.halsning: The light burns as long as I breathe.
rader: The Rotmarch breathes at night. You can hear it.
No one has gone into the cathedral and come out.
The light keeps the Blight away. Don't ask me how.

quest_krokar: Why does the lighthouse keep the Blight away?
fyrvaktaren_hulda.name: Hulda the Lightkeeper
fyrvaktaren_hulda.default_line: The light burns as long as I breathe.

repliker.halsning: Everything has a price. So do you.
rader: I buy from anyone. Even cultists.
The best from the Rotmarch, I sell dear.
I saw Tor the Collier's cart once. Good cart.

quest_krokar: Kram's unknown supplier in the Rotmarch.
kram_handlaren.name: Kram
kram_handlaren.default_line: Everything has a price. So do you.
